description: This file defines the Data Access Object (DAO) class 'ReportScheduleDAO' for managing report schedules, including methods for querying, creating, updating, and deleting report schedule data and related logs in the Superset application.

classes.name: ReportScheduleDAO
classes.description: DAO class for handling report schedule data operations, including querying by various identifiers, validation, creation, update, and log retrieval.

methods.name: find_by_chart_id
methods.description: Retrieve report schedules associated with a specific chart ID.

methods.name: find_by_chart_ids
methods.description: Retrieve report schedules associated with a list of chart IDs.

methods.name: find_by_dashboard_id
methods.description: Retrieve report schedules associated with a specific dashboard ID.

methods.name: find_by_dashboard_ids
methods.description: Retrieve report schedules associated with a list of dashboard IDs.

methods.name: find_by_database_id
methods.description: Retrieve report schedules associated with a specific database ID.

methods.name: find_by_database_ids
methods.description: Retrieve report schedules associated with a list of database IDs.

methods.name: find_by_extra_metadata
methods.description: Retrieve report schedules matching a specific metadata slug.

methods.name: validate_unique_creation_method
methods.description: Check if a user already has a report schedule attached to a specific chart or dashboard.

methods.name: validate_update_uniqueness
methods.description: Validate if a report schedule name and type are unique, optionally expecting a specific ID.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Create a new report schedule, handling nested recipients.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Update an existing report schedule, handling nested recipients.

methods.name: find_last_success_log
methods.description: Get the most recent successful execution log for a report schedule.

methods.name: find_last_entered_working_log
methods.description: Get the most recent 'working' state execution log with no error message for a report schedule.

methods.name: find_last_error_notification
methods.description: Retrieve the last error notification email sent for a report schedule, ensuring no subsequent non-error logs have occurred since.

methods.name: bulk_delete_logs
methods.description: Delete logs older than a specified date for a report schedule.
